segments.text: My name is Ananya Rao. I work at Nimbus Labs in Bengaluru. Karthik Menon is a former colleague. Since early September, he has been messaging and calling me repeatedly.
segments.textEn: My name is Ananya Rao. I work at Nimbus Labs in Bengaluru. Karthik Menon is a former colleague. Since early September, he has been messaging and calling me repeatedly.

segments.text: Even after I told him to stop, he followed me, knew where I live.
segments.textEn: Even after I told him to stop, he followed me, knew where I live.

segments.text: And my blog, and he used new numbers and an Instagram account. On 18th September, he threatened to send private photos to my office and my parents.
segments.textEn: And my blog, and he used new numbers and an Instagram account. On 18th September, he threatened to send private photos to my office and my parents.

segments.text: On twenty-second September he demanded fifteen thousand rupees.
To take down a fake story about me, I paid 25000 rupees on 25.
